{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE authors (
    author_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE publishers (
    publisher_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    publisher_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    founded_year INTEGER,
    independent INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    shelf_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    age_group TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE books (
    book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    publisher_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    publication_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stock_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (publisher_id) REFERENCES publishers(publisher_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(category_id)
);
CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ordered_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE order_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    book_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books(book_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_books_author ON books(author_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_books_category ON books(category_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE pickup_point (
    point_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    point_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE cycle_type (
    type_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    gear_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE cycle_unit (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    serial_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    acquired_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    condition_note TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES cycle_type(type_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (point_id) REFERENCES pickup_point(point_id)
);
CREATE TABLE member_profile (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    membership_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_area TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE hire_record (
    hire_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    hire_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member_profile(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES cycle_unit(cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (start_point_id) REFERENCES pickup_point(point_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (end_point_id) REFERENCES pickup_point(point_id)
);
CREATE TABLE charge_entry (
    charge_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    hire_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (hire_id) REFERENCES hire_record(hire_id)
);","data":"INSERT INTO pickup_point (point_id, point_name, neighborhood, capacity, opened_on) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE veterinarians (
    veterinarian_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE animals (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species TEXT NOT NULL,
    breed TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);
CREATE TABLE appointments (
    appointment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    appointment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animals(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);
CREATE TABLE procedures (
    procedure_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    performed_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(appointment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (performed_by) REFERENCES veterinarians(veterinarian_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(appointment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_animals_client ON animals(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_appointments_date ON appointments(appointment_date);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE cinema_site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    district TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE film (
    film_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    release_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    age_rating TEXT NOT NULL,
    genre TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE staff_member (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES cinema_site(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE screening (
    screening_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    film_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    screening_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    language_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    format_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticket_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES cinema_site(site_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (film_id) REFERENCES film(film_id)
);
CREATE TABLE customer (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    membership_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE ticket_sale (
    sale_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    screening_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seats_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    sale_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (screening_id) REFERENCES screening(screening_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer(customer_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_screening_date ON screening(screening_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_sale_customer ON ticket_sale(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_site ON staff_member(site_id);","data":"INSERT INTO cinema_site (site_id, site_name, district, capacity, opened_year) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE grower (
    grower_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    commune TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    organic_certified INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (organic_certified IN (0,1)),
    active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (active IN (0,1))
);
CREATE TABLE parcel (
    parcel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    grower_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    hectares REAL NOT NULL,
    soil_class TEXT NOT NULL,
    irrigation TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (grower_id) REFERENCES grower(grower_id)
);
CREATE TABLE cultivation (
    cultivation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    parcel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    grower_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    crop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sowing_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_yield_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (parcel_id) REFERENCES parcel(parcel_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (grower_id) REFERENCES grower(grower_id)
);
CREATE TABLE intake (
    intake_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cultivation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    grower_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    received_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    quality_grade TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cultivation_id) REFERENCES cultivation(cultivation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (grower_id) REFERENCES grower(grower_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payout (
    payout_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    intake_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    grower_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    settlement_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (intake_id) REFERENCES intake(intake_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (grower_id) REFERENCES grower(grower_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_parcel_grower ON parcel(grower_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_cultivation_crop ON cultivation(crop_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_intake_received ON intake(received_on);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE depots (
    depot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    district TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE bus_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    line_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    line_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    color_hex TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE stops (
    stop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stop_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    stop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    district TEXT NOT NULL,
    latitude REAL NOT NULL,
    longitude REAL NOT NULL,
    shelter INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE line_stops (
    line_stop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    line_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stop_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minutes_from_origin INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (line_id) REFERENCES bus_lines(line_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (stop_id) REFERENCES stops(stop_id),
    UNIQUE (line_id, stop_id),
    UNIQUE (line_id, stop_order)
);
CREATE TABLE vehicles (
    vehicle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fleet_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    vehicle_model TEXT NOT NULL,
    manufacture_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seat_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    accessibility INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (depot_id) REFERENCES depots(depot_id)
);
CREATE TABLE service_runs (
    run_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    line_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    origin_stop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    destination_stop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    arrival_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    passenger_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    run_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (line_id) REFERENCES bus_lines(line_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (origin_stop_id) REFERENCES stops(stop_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_stop_id) REFERENCES stops(stop_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_line_stops_line ON line_stops(line_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_line_stops_stop ON line_stops(stop_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_vehicles_depot ON vehicles(depot_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_service_runs_date ON service_runs(service_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_service_runs_line ON service_runs(line_id);","data":"INSERT INTO depots (depot_id, depot_name, district, capacity, opened_year) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_complet TEXT NOT NULL,
    telephone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE techniciens (
    technicien_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_complet TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialite TEXT NOT NULL,
    niveau TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_embauche TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE equipements (
    equipement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    marque TEXT NOT NULL,
    modele TEXT NOT NULL,
    numero_serie TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_achat TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);
CREATE TABLE interventions (
    intervention_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    equipement_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    technicien_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_depot TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_cloture TEXT,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL,
    main_oeuvre REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (equipement_id) REFERENCES equipements(equipement_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (technicien_id) REFERENCES techniciens(technicien_id)
);
CREATE TABLE pieces (
    piece_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reference_piece TEXT NOT NULL,
    designation TEXT NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    stock INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE intervention_pieces (
    intervention_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    piece_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_facture REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (intervention_id, piece_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (intervention_id) REFERENCES interventions(intervention_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (piece_id) REFERENCES pieces(piece_id)
);
CREATE TABLE paiements (
    paiement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    intervention_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    montant REAL NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (intervention_id) REFERENCES interventions(intervention_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_equipements_client ON equipements(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_interventions_equipement ON interventions(equipement_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_interventions_technicien ON interventions(technicien_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE service_sites (site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, site_name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL, seating_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, opening_year INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, full_name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL, joined_on TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE offerings (offering_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, offering_name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, vegetarian INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE service_tickets (ticket_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, site_id INTEGER NOT NULL, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, opened_at TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, table_code TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES service_sites(site_id), FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id));
CREATE TABLE ticket_lines (line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ticket_id INTEGER NOT NULL, offering_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES service_tickets(ticket_id), FOREIGN KEY (offering_id) REFERENCES offerings(offering_id));
CREATE TABLE receipts (receipt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ticket_id INTEGER NOT NULL, issued_at TEXT NOT NULL, payment_method TEXT NOT NULL, subtotal REAL NOT NULL, tip_amount REAL NOT NULL, paid_amount REAL NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES service_tickets(ticket_id));
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_site_date ON service_tickets(site_id, opened_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_lines_ticket ON ticket_lines(ticket_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_method ON receipts(payment_method);","data":"INSERT INTO service_sites (site_id, site_name, city, neighborhood, seating_capacity, opening_year) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE athlete (
    athlete_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    skill_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
);
CREATE TABLE coach (
    coach_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE sport_group (
    group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    group_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sport TEXT NOT NULL,
    age_category TEXT NOT NULL,
    coach_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    max_members INTEGER NOT NULL,
    monthly_fee INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (coach_id) REFERENCES coach(coach_id)
);
CREATE TABLE training_session (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    group_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES sport_group(group_id)
);
CREATE TABLE booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    athlete_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    booked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    performance_score INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (athlete_id) REFERENCES athlete(athlete_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES training_session(session_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_group_coach ON sport_group(coach_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_session_group_date ON training_session(group_id, session_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_athlete ON booking(athlete_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_session ON booking(session_id);","data":"INSERT INTO athlete (athlete_id, first_name, last_name, birth_date, city, skill_level, joined_on, active) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE patients (
    patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE professionals (
    professional_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    facility TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    professional_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    clinical_note TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (professional_id) REFERENCES professionals(professional_id)
);
CREATE TABLE specimens (
    specimen_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    collected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    specimen_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    quality_flag TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id)
);
CREATE TABLE assays (
    assay_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    assay_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit TEXT NOT NULL,
    reference_low REAL,
    reference_high REAL,
    price REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE measurements (
    measurement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    specimen_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assay_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    result_value REAL,
    result_text TEXT,
    validated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    abnormal_flag INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (specimen_id) REFERENCES specimens(specimen_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (assay_id) REFERENCES assays(assay_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_patient ON orders(patient_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_professional ON orders(professional_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_specimens_order ON specimens(order_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_measurements_assay ON measurements(assay_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE marina (
    marina_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    town TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE pontoon (
    pontoon_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    marina_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    code TEXT NOT NULL,
    water_depth REAL NOT NULL,
    berth_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (marina_id) REFERENCES marina(marina_id)
);
CREATE TABLE member (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    phone TEXT,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    membership_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE boat (
    boat_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_marina_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    boat_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    length_m REAL NOT NULL,
    draft_m REAL NOT NULL,
    built_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (home_marina_id) REFERENCES marina(marina_id)
);
CREATE TABLE stay_booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    boat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pontoon_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    arrival_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (boat_id) REFERENCES boat(boat_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (pontoon_id) REFERENCES pontoon(pontoon_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE service_order (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    boat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    marina_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_date TEXT,
    cost REAL NOT NULL,
    service_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (boat_id) REFERENCES boat(boat_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (marina_id) REFERENCES marina(marina_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_pontoon_marina ON pontoon(marina_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_boat_member ON boat(member_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_dates ON stay_booking(arrival_date, departure_date);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE depot (
    depot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE worker (
    worker_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (depot_id) REFERENCES depot(depot_id)
);
CREATE TABLE aisle_group (
    group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    group_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    department TEXT NOT NULL,
    taxable INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE item (
    item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    group_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    brand TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    stock_units INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reorder_level INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES aisle_group(group_id)
);
CREATE TABLE buyer (
    buyer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE ticket (
    ticket_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    worker_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    buyer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sold_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (depot_id) REFERENCES depot(depot_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES worker(worker_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (buyer_id) REFERENCES buyer(buyer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ticket_line (
    ticket_line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ticket_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES ticket(ticket_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES item(item_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_item_group ON item(group_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_date ON ticket(sold_on);

content.text:
{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE supporter (
    supporter_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    supporter_type TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE appeal (
    appeal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    cause TEXT NOT NULL,
    launch_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    closing_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE contribution (
    contribution_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    supporter_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    appeal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    contributed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (supporter_id) REFERENCES supporter(supporter_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (appeal_id) REFERENCES appeal(appeal_id)
);
CREATE TABLE helper (
    helper_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    skill_area TEXT NOT NULL,
    availability TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE outreach_event (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    appeal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    coordinator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    venue TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_attendance INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (appeal_id) REFERENCES appeal(appeal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (coordinator_id) REFERENCES helper(helper_id)
);
CREATE TABLE event_assignment (
    assignment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    helper_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    hours_committed REAL NOT NULL,
    attendance_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES outreach_event(event_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (helper_id) REFERENCES helper(helper_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_contribution_appeal ON contribution(appeal_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_contribution_supporter ON contribution(supporter_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_segment TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE agents (
    agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    office_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    annual_fee REAL NOT NULL,
    coverage_limit REAL NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE policies (
    policy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    policy_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    premium REAL NOT NULL,
    policy_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE claims (
    claim_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    handler_agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    incident_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    reported_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    claim_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    approved_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    claim_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies(policy_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (handler_agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claim_id INTEGER,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies(policy_id),

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE staff (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    home_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE vehicles (
    vehicle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    registration_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    vehicle_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity_m3 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hourly_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    current_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    available INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE relocations (
    relocation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    coordinator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scheduled_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    destination_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    property_size_m2 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    quoted_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    final_amount REAL,
    distance_km INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (coordinator_id) REFERENCES staff(staff_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id)
);
CREATE TABLE relocation_crew (
    relocation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assignment_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hours_worked REAL NOT NULL,
    overtime_hours REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (relocation_id, staff_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (relocation_id) REFERENCES relocations(relocation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(staff_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_relocations_date ON relocations(scheduled_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_relocations_customer ON relocations(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_crew_staff ON relocation_crew(staff_id);","data":"INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, full_name, phone, email, customer_type, city, created_on) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE service_zone (
    zone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    zone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority_level INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active_from TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE customer_profile (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_tier TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES service_zone(zone_id)
);
CREATE TABLE courier_agent (
    courier_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    vehicle_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    rating REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES service_zone(zone_id)
);
CREATE TABLE delivery_order (
    delivery_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pickup_zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    courier_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    package_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    promised_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivered_at TEXT,
    delivery_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer_profile(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (pickup_zone_id) REFERENCES service_zone(zone_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (courier_id) REFERENCES courier_agent(courier_id)
);
CREATE TABLE delivery_event (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    courier_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    location_note TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (delivery_id) REFERENCES delivery_order(delivery_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (courier_id) REFERENCES courier_agent(courier_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_customer_zone ON customer_profile(zone_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_courier_zone ON courier_agent(zone_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_delivery_customer ON delivery_order(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_delivery_status ON delivery_order(delivery_status);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE nursery_site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_m2 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE plant_catalog (
    plant_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    common_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    botanical_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    plant_group TEXT NOT NULL,
    pot_size_cm INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    stock_qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

);

    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_type TEXT NOT NULL
);

    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,

);

);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_since TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE vehicles (
    vehicle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registration_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    make TEXT NOT NULL,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    production_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fuel_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    mileage INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE mechanics (
    mechanic_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE work_orders (
    work_order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mechanic_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_on TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    estimated_total REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (mechanic_id) REFERENCES mechanics(mechanic_id)
);
CREATE TABLE work_order_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    work_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    line_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity REAL NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (work_order_id) REFERENCES work_orders(work_order_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    work_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (work_order_id) REFERENCES work_orders(work_order_id)
);

    shelf_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    shelf_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_number INTEGER NOT NULL,

);

    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,

    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,

    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,

    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    contributor_type TEXT NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    sector TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);
CREATE TABLE employees (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE projects (
    project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lead_employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    project_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    budget_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lead_employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);
CREATE TABLE project_staff (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assignment_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    planned_hours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, employee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);
CREATE TABLE milestones (
    milestone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    milestone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    milestone_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    planned_cost_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id)
);
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    invoice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    invoice_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    paid_date TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_client ON projects(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_lead ON projects(lead_employee_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_project_staff_employee ON project_staff(employee_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_milestones_project ON milestones(project_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE park (
    park_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    park_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_km2 REAL NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE sector (
    sector_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    park_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sector_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    habitat_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    altitude_m INTEGER NOT NULL,

);
CREATE TABLE trail (
    trail_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    sector_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    trail_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    difficulty TEXT NOT NULL,
    length_km REAL NOT NULL,
    elevation_gain_m INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (sector_id) REFERENCES sector(sector_id)
);
CREATE TABLE species (
    species_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    common_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species_group TEXT NOT NULL,
    protection_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE trail_species (
    trail_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    first_record_year INTEGER NOT NULL,

    branch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    manager_name TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE borrower (
    borrower_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    occupation TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branch_office(branch_id)
);
CREATE TABLE credit_plan (
    plan_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    plan_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
    annual_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    maximum_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    duration_months INTEGER NOT NULL
);

    agreement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    borrower_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    signed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    principal_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (borrower_id) REFERENCES borrower(borrower_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branch_office(branch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES credit_plan(plan_id)
);
CREATE TABLE repayment (
    repayment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    agreement_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    due_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT,
    amount_due REAL NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (agreement_id) REFERENCES credit_agreement(agreement_id)

    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    balance REAL NOT NULL,
    account_status TEXT NOT NULL,

);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE venues (
    venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    venue_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE conferences (
    conference_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    conference_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venues(venue_id)
);
CREATE TABLE people (
    person_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    organization TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    conference_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (conference_id) REFERENCES conferences(conference_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venues(venue_id)
);
CREATE TABLE registrations (
    registration_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    conference_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    person_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticket_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    registration_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (conference_id) REFERENCES conferences(conference_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES people(person_id)
);
CREATE TABLE session_attendance (
    attendance_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    person_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    check_in_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    feedback_score INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES people(person_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_conferences_dates ON conferences(start_date, end_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_conference_date ON sessions(conference_id, session_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_registrations_conference ON registrations(conference_id);

    active_flag INTEGER NOT NULL

    player_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    country_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,

    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (away_team_id) REFERENCES esports_team(team_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (winner_team_id) REFERENCES esports_team(team_id)
);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE hubs (
    hub_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    hub_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    country_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    platform_count INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE corridors (
    corridor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    origin_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    destination_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    corridor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km INTEGER NOT NULL,
    standard_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_class TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (origin_hub_id) REFERENCES hubs(hub_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_hub_id) REFERENCES hubs(hub_id)
);
CREATE TABLE units (
    unit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    unit_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    unit_model TEXT NOT NULL,
    seat_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    manufacture_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    energy_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    operational_status TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE runs (
    run_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    corridor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    arrival_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_fare REAL NOT NULL,
    run_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (corridor_id) REFERENCES corridors(corridor_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES units(unit_id)
);
CREATE TABLE travelers (
    traveler_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    given_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    family_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    loyalty_tier TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_city TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE reservations (
    reservation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    traveler_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    boarding_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    alighting_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seat_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    paid_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    reservation_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    booked_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (traveler_id) REFERENCES travelers(traveler_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (boarding_hub_id) REFERENCES hubs(hub_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (alighting_hub_id) REFERENCES hubs(hub_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_runs_service_date ON runs(service_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_reservations_run ON reservations(run_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_corridors_origin ON corridors(origin_hub_id);","data":"INSERT INTO hubs (hub_id, hub_name, city_name, region_name, country_code, platform_count) VALUES

    pharmacy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    pharmacy_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    postal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_hour TEXT NOT NULL,
    closing_hour TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE employees (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    pharmacy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (pharmacy_id) REFERENCES pharmacies(pharmacy_id)
);
CREATE TABLE patients (
    patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT,
    city TEXT NOT NULL
);

    medicine_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    medicine_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_ingredient TEXT NOT NULL,
    dosage TEXT NOT NULL,
    medicine_form TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    prescription_required INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stock_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL

    patient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pharmacy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    prescribed_on TEXT NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE recycling_depot (
    depot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    daily_capacity_kg INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE material_catalog (
    material_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    material_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    material_family TEXT NOT NULL,
    hazard_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    recyclable_ratio REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE business_actor (
    actor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE intake_record (
    intake_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    intake_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (depot_id) REFERENCES recycling_depot(depot_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES business_actor(actor_id)
);
CREATE TABLE intake_detail (
    intake_detail_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    intake_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    contamination_pct REAL NOT NULL,
    quality_grade TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (intake_id) REFERENCES intake_record(intake_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (material_id) REFERENCES material_catalog(material_id)
);
CREATE TABLE dispatch_record (
    dispatch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dispatch_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    destination TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    dispatch_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (depot_id) REFERENCES recycling_depot(depot_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES business_actor(actor_id)
);
CREATE TABLE dispatch_detail (
    dispatch_detail_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dispatch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    material_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    price_per_tonne REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (dispatch_id) REFERENCES dispatch_record(dispatch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (material_id) REFERENCES material_catalog(material_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_intake_depot_date ON intake_record(depot_id, intake_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_intake_detail_material ON intake_detail(material_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_dispatch_actor_date ON dispatch_record(actor_id, dispatch_date);

    studio_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    studio_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_area_m2 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE instructor (
    instructor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);

    learner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    skill_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

    instructor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,

    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_mode TEXT NOT NULL,

    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

    region TEXT NOT NULL,

    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

    kind_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

    scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    preferred_temp_c REAL NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE pond_unit (
    pond_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

    water_type TEXT NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES farm_site(site_id)
);

    pond_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stocked_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    initial_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    current_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    avg_weight_g REAL NOT NULL,
    health_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (pond_id) REFERENCES pond_unit(pond_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (kind_id) REFERENCES fish_kind(kind_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ration_log (
    ration_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    lot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    feed_type TEXT NOT NULL,

);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE venues (
    venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE auditoriums (
    auditorium_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    seat_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    accessibility_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venues(venue_id)
);
CREATE TABLE productions (
    production_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    company TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minimum_age INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE artists (
    artist_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_city TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    production_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    auditorium_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_price REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (production_id) REFERENCES productions(production_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (auditorium_id) REFERENCES auditoriums(auditorium_id)
);
CREATE TABLE session_artists (
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    artist_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    billing_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, artist_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (artist_id) REFERENCES artists(artist_id)
);
CREATE TABLE reservations (
    reservation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    seats_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    booked_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_auditoriums_venue ON auditoriums(venue_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_production ON sessions(production_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_date ON sessions(starts_at);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE employee_roster (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    department_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_monthly_salary REAL NOT NULL,
    active_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE salary_cycles (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_label TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    period_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_end TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    cycle_status TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE pay_batches (
    batch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gross_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    tax_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    social_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    net_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    processed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    batch_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employee_roster(employee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES salary_cycles(cycle_id)
);
CREATE TABLE pay_entries (
    entry_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    entry_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entry_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    taxable_flag INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES pay_batches(batch_id)
);
CREATE TABLE staff_benefits (
    benefit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    benefit_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    monthly_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    employer_share REAL NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    benefit_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employee_roster(employee_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_pay_batches_employee ON pay_batches(employee_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_pay_batches_cycle ON pay_batches(cycle_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_pay_entries_batch ON pay_entries(batch_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_benefits_employee ON staff_benefits(employee_id);","data":"INSERT INTO employee_roster (employee_id, employee_code, full_name, department_name, job_title, hire_date, contract_type, base_monthly_salary, active_flag) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE complexes (
    complex_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    construction_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    manager_name TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE residents (
    resident_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    resident_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE lots (
    lot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    complex_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lot_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    lot_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    area_m2 REAL NOT NULL,
    share_milliemes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (complex_id) REFERENCES complexes(complex_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ownerships (
    ownership_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    lot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resident_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ownership_percent REAL NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (lot_id) REFERENCES lots(lot_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (resident_id) REFERENCES residents(resident_id)
);
CREATE TABLE fund_calls (
    call_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    complex_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    call_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_total REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (complex_id) REFERENCES complexes(complex_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    call_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resident_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    reference_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (call_id) REFERENCES fund_calls(call_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (resident_id) REFERENCES residents(resident_id)
);
CREATE TABLE meetings (
    meeting_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    complex_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    meeting_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    meeting_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    approved_budget REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (complex_id) REFERENCES complexes(complex_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_lots_complex ON lots(complex_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ownerships_resident ON ownerships(resident_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_calls_complex ON fund_calls(complex_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_payments_call ON payments(call_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_meetings_complex ON meetings(complex_id);","data":"INSERT INTO complexes (complex_id, dataset_code, name, address, city, construction_year, manager_name) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE destination_area (
    area_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    area_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    country_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    climate_band TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_since INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE stay_property (
    property_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    property_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    room_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    nightly_rate INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (area_id) REFERENCES destination_area(area_id)
);
CREATE TABLE tour_package (
    package_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    package_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lead_property_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_days INTEGER NOT NULL,
    base_price INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_month TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (area_id) REFERENCES destination_area(area_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lead_property_id) REFERENCES stay_property(property_id)
);
CREATE TABLE activity_catalog (
    activity_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    activity_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    activity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    activity_price INTEGER NOT NULL,
    difficulty_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (area_id) REFERENCES destination_area(area_id)

    package_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    activity_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scheduled_day INTEGER NOT NULL,
    participant_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (package_id) REFERENCES tour_package(package_id),

);
CREATE TABLE traveler (
    traveler_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_country TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);

    traveler_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    booking_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    travelers_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    total_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    reservation_status TEXT NOT NULL,

);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE species (
    species_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    common_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    typical_lifespan_years INTEGER NOT NULL,
    care_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE kennel (
    kennel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    kennel_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    zone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    indoor INTEGER NOT NULL,
    daily_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE staff_member (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE adopter (
    adopter_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    housing_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    has_yard INTEGER NOT NULL,
    household_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE animal (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kennel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    arrival_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    health_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    temperament TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (species_id) REFERENCES species(species_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (kennel_id) REFERENCES kennel(kennel_id)
);
CREATE TABLE adoption (
    adoption_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    adopter_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_at TEXT,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    adoption_fee REAL NOT NULL,
    follow_up_score INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animal(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (adopter_id) REFERENCES adopter(adopter_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff_member(staff_id)
);

    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    catalog_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    capacity_liters INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beers (
    beer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    beer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    style TEXT NOT NULL,

    ibu INTEGER NOT NULL,

);

    ingredient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ingredient_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    ingredient_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin_country TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    organic_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);

    beer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    use_stage TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (beer_id, ingredient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (beer_id) REFERENCES beers(beer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients(ingredient_id)
);

);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_complet TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL,
    niveau_fidelite TEXT NOT NULL,
    budget_moyen REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE employes (
    employe_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_complet TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialite TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_embauche TEXT NOT NULL,
    taux_horaire REAL NOT NULL,
    actif INTEGER NOT NULL
);

    tissu_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    matiere TEXT NOT NULL,
    couleur TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_au_metre REAL NOT NULL,
    stock_metres REAL NOT NULL,

    tarif_base REAL NOT NULL,
    niveau_difficulte TEXT NOT NULL
);

    date_commande TEXT NOT NULL,

    statut TEXT NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE security_sites (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_sector TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE guards (
    guard_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    certification TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE service_contracts (
    contract_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    contract_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    client_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    monthly_fee REAL NOT NULL,
    priority_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES security_sites(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE duty_rosters (
    shift_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    contract_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    guard_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    shift_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    shift_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    hours_worked REAL NOT NULL,
    shift_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (contract_id) REFERENCES service_contracts(contract_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (guard_id) REFERENCES guards(guard_id)
);
CREATE TABLE incident_reports (
    incident_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    shift_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    incident_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolution_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    loss_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (shift_id) REFERENCES duty_rosters(shift_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_contracts_site ON service_contracts(site_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rosters_guard ON duty_rosters(guard_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rosters_contract ON duty_rosters(contract_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE member (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    member_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (member_role IN ('driver','passenger','both')),
    trust_score REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE vehicle (
    vehicle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    make TEXT NOT NULL,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    seats INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fuel_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    year_built INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ride (
    ride_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    driver_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    arrival_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seats_available INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ride_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ride_status IN ('planned','completed','cancelled')),
    FOREIGN KEY (driver_id) REFERENCES member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicle(vehicle_id)
);
CREATE TABLE booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ride_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    passenger_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    seats_booked INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booking_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (booking_status IN ('confirmed','completed','cancelled')),
    FOREIGN KEY (ride_id) REFERENCES ride(ride_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (passenger_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_status IN ('paid','refunded','pending')),
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('card','wallet','bank_transfer')),
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES booking(booking_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (payer_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE rating (
    rating_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    target_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    score INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (score BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment TEXT NOT NULL,
    rated_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES booking(booking_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (target_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_vehicle_owner ON vehicle(owner_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ride_driver_date ON ride(driver_id, departure_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_ride ON booking(ride_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_payment_booking ON payment(booking_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rating_target ON rating(target_id);","data":"INSERT INTO member (member_id, display_name, email, city, joined_on, member_role, trust_score) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE coffee_shop (
    shop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    shop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    seating_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE staff_member (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    shop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (shop_id) REFERENCES coffee_shop(shop_id)
);
CREATE TABLE guest (
    guest_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_tier TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    favorite_city TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beverage (
    beverage_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    beverage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    beverage_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    size_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    price REAL NOT NULL,
    dairy_free INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seasonal INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE purchase (
    purchase_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    shop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    guest_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    purchased_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    subtotal REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (shop_id) REFERENCES coffee_shop(shop_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (guest_id) REFERENCES guest(guest_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff_member(staff_id)
);
CREATE TABLE purchase_item (
    purchase_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    purchase_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    beverage_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (purchase_id) REFERENCES purchase(purchase_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (beverage_id) REFERENCES beverage(beverage_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_shop ON staff_member(shop_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_purchase_shop_date ON purchase(shop_id, purchased_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_purchase_item_purchase ON purchase_item(purchase_id);","data":"INSERT INTO coffee_shop (shop_id, shop_name, city, neighborhood, opened_on, seating_capacity) VALUES

    agency_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    agency_name TEXT NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE client (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE veterinarian (
    veterinarian_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE animal (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species TEXT NOT NULL,
    breed TEXT NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES client(client_id)
);
CREATE TABLE visit (
    visit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    visit_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    diagnosis TEXT NOT NULL,
    visit_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    fee REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animal(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarian(veterinarian_id)
);
CREATE TABLE medication (
    medication_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_ingredient TEXT NOT NULL,
    form TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    stock_units INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE prescription (
    prescription_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    medication_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    veterinarian_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dosage TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_days INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prescribed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    instructions TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (visit_id) REFERENCES visit(visit_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medication(medication_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (veterinarian_id) REFERENCES veterinarian(veterinarian_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_animal_client ON animal(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_visit_animal ON visit(animal_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_visit_veterinarian ON visit(veterinarian_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_prescription_visit ON prescription(visit_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_prescription_medication ON prescription(medication_id);","data":"INSERT INTO client (client_id, full_name, phone, email, city, joined_on) VALUES

    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    quartier TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacite_accueil INTEGER NOT NULL,

);

    salle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE cooperative_unit (
    cooperative_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    unit_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    certification_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE member (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cooperative_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    commune TEXT NOT NULL,
    farm_size_ha REAL NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cooperative_id) REFERENCES cooperative_unit(cooperative_id)
);
CREATE TABLE plot (
    plot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    plot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    area_ha REAL NOT NULL,
    soil_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    irrigation TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE crop_cycle (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    plot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    crop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sowing_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    harvest_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_tons REAL NOT NULL,
    organic_flag INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cycle_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (plot_id) REFERENCES plot(plot_id)
);
CREATE TABLE delivery (
    delivery_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    delivered_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_tons REAL NOT NULL,
    quality_grade TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    delivery_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES crop_cycle(cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (delivery_id) REFERENCES delivery(delivery_id)
);","data":"INSERT INTO cooperative_unit (cooperative_id, unit_name, region, certification_level, joined_on) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE operator_company (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);
CREATE TABLE garage (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    operator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (operator_id) REFERENCES operator_company(id)
);
CREATE TABLE stop_point (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    zone INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE bus_line (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    operator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    night_service INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (operator_id) REFERENCES operator_company(id)
);
CREATE TABLE bus_vehicle (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    garage_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fleet_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    commissioned_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (garage_id) REFERENCES garage(id)
);
CREATE TABLE line_stop (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    line_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stop_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stop_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minutes_from_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (line_id) REFERENCES bus_line(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (stop_id) REFERENCES stop_point(id),
    UNIQUE (line_id, stop_order)
);
CREATE TABLE scheduled_trip (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    line_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    trip_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (line_id) REFERENCES bus_line(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES bus_vehicle(id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_garage_operator ON garage(operator_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_line_operator ON bus_line(operator_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_vehicle_garage ON bus_vehicle(garage_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_line_stop_line ON line_stop(line_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_line_stop_stop ON line_stop(stop_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_trip_date ON scheduled_trip(service_date);","data":"INSERT INTO operator_company (id, name, city, license_code) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE customer_profile (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE technician (
    technician_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE asset (
    asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    asset_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    brand TEXT NOT NULL,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    serial_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    purchase_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer_profile(customer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE work_order (
    work_order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    technician_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_on TEXT,
    issue_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    labor_hours REAL NOT NULL,
    labor_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (asset_id) REFERENCES asset(asset_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (technician_id) REFERENCES technician(technician_id)
);
CREATE TABLE part_catalog (
    part_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    part_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    supplier TEXT NOT NULL,
    stock_count INTEGER NOT NULL

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE sites (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE intervenants (
    intervenant_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);

    parcours_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    domain TEXT NOT NULL,
    level TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_hours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES sites(site_id)
);

    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    parcours_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    intervenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivery_mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    seats INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (parcours_id) REFERENCES parcours(parcours_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (intervenant_id) REFERENCES intervenants(intervenant_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES sites(site_id)
);

    participant_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employment_status TEXT NOT NULL
);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE branch_office (
    branch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    district TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE broker_agent (
    agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branch_office(branch_id)
);

CREATE TABLE customer_profile (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    budget_max INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE property_asset (
    property_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    owner_customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    property_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    address_line TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    district TEXT NOT NULL,
    bedrooms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    area_sqm INTEGER NOT NULL,
    asking_price INTEGER NOT NULL,
    energy_rating TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branch_office(branch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (owner_customer_id) REFERENCES customer_profile(customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE property_listing (
    listing_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    property_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    listing_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    published_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    commission_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES property_asset(property_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES broker_agent(agent_id)
);

CREATE TABLE property_viewing (
    viewing_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    viewing_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES property_listing(listing_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer_profile(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES broker_agent(agent_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_agent_branch ON broker_agent(branch_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_property_city_price ON property_asset(city, asking_price);
CREATE INDEX idx_listing_status ON property_listing(status);
