{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE festival_cycle (
    cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    edition_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    closing_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE venue_slot (
    venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    covered INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);
CREATE TABLE performer (
    performer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stage_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    music_style TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    booking_fee INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE set_listing (
    set_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    venue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    performer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    set_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_estimate INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venue_slot(venue_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (performer_id) REFERENCES performer(performer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE event_partner (
    partner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    partner_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    partnership_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    contribution_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES festival_cycle(cycle_id)
);
CREATE TABLE pass_order (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pass_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    buyer_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sales_channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE museum_site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    focus TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE gallery_room (
    room_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES museum_site(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE curator (
    curator_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hired_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES museum_site(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE artifact (
    artifact_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin_region TEXT NOT NULL,
    creation_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    material TEXT NOT NULL,
    estimated_value REAL NOT NULL,
    room_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    curator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES gallery_room(room_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (curator_id) REFERENCES curator(curator_id)
);
CREATE TABLE exhibition (
    exhibition_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lead_curator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    admission_fee REAL NOT NULL,

    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seating_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_style TEXT NOT NULL
);

    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,

);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE patients (
    patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    external_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE practitioners (
    practitioner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    license_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    facility TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE test_catalog (
    test_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    test_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    test_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specimen_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    department TEXT NOT NULL,
    turnaround_hours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reference_unit TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_price REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE lab_orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    practitioner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    collection_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    clinical_note TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (practitioner_id) REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id)
);
CREATE TABLE order_lines (
    line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    test_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sample_barcode TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    line_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    billed_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES lab_orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (test_id) REFERENCES test_catalog(test_id)
);
CREATE TABLE test_results (
    result_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    line_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    result_value REAL NOT NULL,
    result_text TEXT,
    validation_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    measured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    validated_by INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (line_id) REFERENCES order_lines(line_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (validated_by) REFERENCES practitioners(practitioner_id)
);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE marina_site (site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dataset_key TEXT NOT NULL, site_name TEXT NOT NULL, town TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL, capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, opening_month INTEGER NOT NULL, annual_fee REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE pier_slot (slot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dataset_key TEXT NOT NULL, site_id INTEGER NOT NULL, pontoon_code TEXT NOT NULL, slot_number INTEGER NOT NULL, length_m REAL NOT NULL, width_m REAL NOT NULL, water_depth_m REAL NOT NULL, monthly_rate REAL NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES marina_site(site_id));

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE magasin (
    magasin_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    surface_m2 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ouvert_depuis INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE famille (
    famille_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    rayon TEXT NOT NULL,
    taux_tva REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE article (
    article_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    famille_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    marque TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_public REAL NOT NULL,
    unite TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (famille_id) REFERENCES famille(famille_id)
);
CREATE TABLE fournisseur (
    fournisseur_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    raison_sociale TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    pays TEXT NOT NULL,
    delai_jours INTEGER NOT NULL,
    evaluation REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE offre_fournisseur (
    offre_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fournisseur_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    article_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_achat REAL NOT NULL,
    minimum_commande INTEGER NOT NULL,
    disponible INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (fournisseur_id) REFERENCES fournisseur(fournisseur_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES article(article_id),
    UNIQUE (fournisseur_id, article_id)
);
CREATE TABLE client (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    prenom TEXT NOT NULL,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    type_client TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE ticket (
    ticket_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    magasin_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    client_id INTEGER,
    date_vente TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (magasin_id) REFERENCES magasin(magasin_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES client(client_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ligne_ticket (
    ligne_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ticket_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    article_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    remise REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES ticket(ticket_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (article_id) REFERENCES article(article_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_article_famille ON article(famille_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_offre_article ON offre_fournisseur(article_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_date ON ticket(date_vente);
CREATE INDEX idx_ligne_ticket ON ligne_ticket(ticket_id);","data":"INSERT INTO magasin (magasin_id, nom, ville, region, surface_m2, ouvert_depuis) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE agents (
    agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    office_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    commission_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    coverage_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_premium REAL NOT NULL,
    deductible REAL NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE policies (
    policy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    policy_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    annual_premium REAL NOT NULL,
    policy_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE claims (
    claim_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    incident_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    report_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    claim_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    approved_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    claim_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies(policy_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claim_id INTEGER,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies(policy_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES claims(claim_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_policies_client ON policies(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_policies_agent ON policies(agent_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_claims_policy ON claims(policy_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    postal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE staff_members (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE trucks (
    truck_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    registration_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    truck_model TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity_m3 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    inspection_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE relocations (
    relocation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    coordinator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    truck_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    origin_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    destination_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    scheduled_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quoted_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    actual_amount REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (coordinator_id) REFERENCES staff_members(staff_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (truck_id) REFERENCES trucks(truck_id)
);
CREATE TABLE relocation_crew (
    crew_assignment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    relocation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assignment_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hours_worked REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (relocation_id) REFERENCES relocations(relocation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff_members(staff_id)
);
CREATE TABLE relocation_options (
    option_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    relocation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    option_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity REAL NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (relocation_id) REFERENCES relocations(relocation_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_relocations_customer ON relocations(customer_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE lodgings (
    lodging_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    lodging_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    star_rating INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE room_categories (
    room_category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    lodging_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    bed_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    max_guests INTEGER NOT NULL,
    base_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (lodging_id) REFERENCES lodgings(lodging_id)
);
CREATE TABLE travelers (
    traveler_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    home_country TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE stays (
    stay_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    traveler_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lodging_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    confirmation_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    arrival_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    stay_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    guest_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booking_channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    quoted_total REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (traveler_id) REFERENCES travelers(traveler_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lodging_id) REFERENCES lodgings(lodging_id)
);
CREATE TABLE stay_units (
    stay_unit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stay_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    nightly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    night_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (stay_id) REFERENCES stays(stay_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (room_category_id) REFERENCES room_categories(room_category_id)
);
CREATE TABLE charges (
    charge_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stay_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    charged_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    charge_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (stay_id) REFERENCES stays(stay_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_room_categories_lodging ON room_categories(lodging_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_stays_traveler ON stays(traveler_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_stays_dates ON stays(arrival_date, departure_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_stay_units_stay ON stay_units(stay_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_charges_stay ON charges(stay_id);","data":"INSERT INTO lodgings (lodging_id, dataset_code, lodging_name, city, country, star_rating, opened_year) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE riders (
    rider_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    vehicle_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    rating REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE depots (
    depot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    depot_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE deliveries (
    delivery_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rider_id INTEGER,
    origin_depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    destination_depot_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    requested_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivered_date TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    delivery_fee REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (rider_id) REFERENCES riders(rider_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (origin_depot_id) REFERENCES depots(depot_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_depot_id) REFERENCES depots(depot_id)
);
CREATE TABLE parcels (
    parcel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    contents TEXT NOT NULL,
    weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    declared_value REAL NOT NULL,
    fragile INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (delivery_id) REFERENCES deliveries(delivery_id)
);

    update_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rider_id INTEGER,
    update_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    update_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL,
    note TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (delivery_id) REFERENCES deliveries(delivery_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (rider_id) REFERENCES riders(rider_id)
);","data":"INSERT INTO clients (client_id, full_name, phone, city, signup_date, loyalty_level) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE plant_variety (variety_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, botanical_name TEXT NOT NULL, common_name TEXT NOT NULL, plant_type TEXT NOT NULL, sun_exposure TEXT NOT NULL, hardiness_zone TEXT NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE supplier (supplier_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, company_name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL, contact_email TEXT NOT NULL, organic_certified INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE nursery_section (section_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, section_name TEXT NOT NULL, location_type TEXT NOT NULL, climate_control TEXT NOT NULL, capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE stock_lot (lot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, variety_id INTEGER NOT NULL, supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL, section_id INTEGER NOT NULL, received_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_cost REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (variety_id) REFERENCES plant_variety(variety_id), FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES supplier(supplier_id), FOREIGN KEY (section_id) REFERENCES nursery_section(section_id));
CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_name TEXT NOT NULL, customer_type TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE sales_order (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_date TEXT, channel TEXT NOT NULL, order_status TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customer(customer_id));
CREATE TABLE sales_order_line (line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, variety_id INTEGER NOT NULL, lot_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, discount_rate REAL NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES sales_order(order_id), FOREIGN KEY (variety_id) REFERENCES plant_variety(variety_id), FOREIGN KEY (lot_id) REFERENCES stock_lot(lot_id));
CREATE INDEX idx_stock_lot_variety ON stock_lot(variety_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_stock_lot_section ON stock_lot(section_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sales_order_customer ON sales_order(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_order_line_order ON sales_order_line(order_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_since TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE vehicles (
    vehicle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registration_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    make TEXT NOT NULL,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mileage INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fuel_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE employees (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE service_jobs (
    job_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_on TEXT,
    job_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    odometer INTEGER NOT NULL,
    labor_hours REAL NOT NULL,
    labor_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    service_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);
CREATE TABLE inventory_items (
    item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    supplier_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL,
    stock_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reorder_level INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE job_items (
    job_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES service_jobs(job_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES inventory_items(item_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_vehicles_customer ON vehicles(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_vehicle ON service_jobs(vehicle_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_employee ON service_jobs(employee_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_job_items_job ON job_items(job_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_job_items_item ON job_items(item_id);","data":"INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, dataset_code, full_name, city, phone, customer_since) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sector TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    signed_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE employees (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    daily_rate INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE projects (
    project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lead_employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    project_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    planned_end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    budget_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lead_employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);
CREATE TABLE project_assignments (
    assignment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assignment_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    allocation_percent INTEGER NOT NULL,
    assigned_from TEXT NOT NULL,
    assigned_to TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);

    invoice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    invoice_number TEXT NOT NULL,
    issued_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    due_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);
CREATE TABLE milestones (
    milestone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    owner_employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    milestone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_on TEXT,
    milestone_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (owner_employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id)
);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE agencies (
    agency_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    agency_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    agency_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    manager_name TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE members (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    agency_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    income_band TEXT NOT NULL,
    member_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(agency_id)
);
CREATE TABLE loan_products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    loan_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    annual_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    max_term_months INTEGER NOT NULL,
    secured_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE loans (
    loan_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agency_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    application_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    approval_date TEXT,
    principal_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    term_months INTEGER NOT NULL,
    installment_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    loan_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    outstanding_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(agency_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES loan_products(product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE repayments (
    repayment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    loan_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    paid_date TEXT,
    amount_due REAL NOT NULL,
    amount_paid REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    repayment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (loan_id) REFERENCES loans(loan_id)
);
CREATE TABLE savings_accounts (
    account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agency_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    account_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    opened_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    balance REAL NOT NULL,
    account_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agency_id) REFERENCES agencies(agency_id)
);
CREATE TABLE savings_entries (
    entry_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    entry_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    entry_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    channel TEXT NOT NULL,
    reference_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES savings_accounts(account_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_members_agency ON members(agency_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_loans_member ON loans(member_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_loans_status ON loans(loan_status);
CREATE INDEX idx_repayments_loan ON repayments(loan_id);

content.text:
{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    accessibility_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE summit (
    summit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    summit_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    budget_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES site(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE attendee (
    attendee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    organization TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE agenda_item (
    agenda_item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    summit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    starts_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (summit_id) REFERENCES summit(summit_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES site(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE agenda_contributor (
    agenda_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attendee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    contribution_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    speaking_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (agenda_item_id, attendee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agenda_item_id) REFERENCES agenda_item(agenda_item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (attendee_id) REFERENCES attendee(attendee_id)
);
CREATE TABLE enrollment (
    enrollment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    summit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attendee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registered_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    ticket_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_eur INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attendance_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (summit_id) REFERENCES summit(summit_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (attendee_id) REFERENCES attendee(attendee_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_summit_dates ON summit(start_date, end_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_agenda_summit_time ON agenda_item(summit_id, starts_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_summit ON enrollment(summit_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_contributor_attendee ON agenda_contributor(attendee_id);","data":"INSERT INTO site (site_id, site_name, city, country, capacity, accessibility_level) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE market_days (
    market_day_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    market_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    market_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_note TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE vendors (
    vendor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    vendor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    town TEXT NOT NULL,
    organic_certified INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (organic_certified IN (0,1))
);
CREATE TABLE stalls (
    stall_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    vendor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stall_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    aisle_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(vendor_id)
);
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stall_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    seasonal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seasonal IN (0,1)),
    FOREIGN KEY (stall_id) REFERENCES stalls(stall_id)
);
CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE market_orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    market_day_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stall_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (market_day_id) REFERENCES market_days(market_day_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (stall_id) REFERENCES stalls(stall_id)
);
CREATE TABLE order_lines (
    order_line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES market_orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clubs (
    club_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    club_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_region TEXT NOT NULL,
    founded_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sponsor_tier INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active_flag INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE athletes (
    athlete_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gamer_tag TEXT NOT NULL,
    real_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    monthly_salary INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);
CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    game_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    prize_pool INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE fixtures (
    fixture_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    away_club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scheduled_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    best_of INTEGER NOT NULL,
    winner_club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (home_club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (away_club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (winner_club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);
CREATE TABLE contracts (
    contract_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    athlete_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    signed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    buyout_value INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (athlete_id) REFERENCES athletes(athlete_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);
CREATE TABLE fixture_entries (
    fixture_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    club_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    side_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    rounds_won INTEGER NOT NULL,
    player_rating REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fixture_id, club_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (fixture_id) REFERENCES fixtures(fixture_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(club_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_athletes_club ON athletes(club_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_fixtures_event ON fixtures(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_contracts_club ON contracts(club_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_entries_club ON fixture_entries(club_id);","data":"INSERT INTO clubs (club_id, club_name, home_region, founded_year, sponsor_tier, active_flag) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    phone TEXT,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    registered_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE photographers (
    photographer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    daily_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE packages (
    package_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    package_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    edited_photos INTEGER NOT NULL,
    base_price REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE photo_sessions (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    photographer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    package_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (photographer_id) REFERENCES photographers(photographer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id) REFERENCES packages(package_id)
);
CREATE TABLE services (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    service_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    turnaround_days INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE session_services (
    session_service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agreed_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES photo_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(service_id)
);
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    invoice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    issued_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    due_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES photo_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_date ON photo_sessions(session_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_client ON photo_sessions(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_session_services_session ON session_services(session_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE rail_hub (
    hub_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    hub_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    platform_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE line_segment (
    segment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    segment_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    start_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
    electrified INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (start_hub_id) REFERENCES rail_hub(hub_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (end_hub_id) REFERENCES rail_hub(hub_id)
);
CREATE TABLE rolling_unit (
    unit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    unit_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    model_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    seat_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    propulsion TEXT NOT NULL,
    home_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    in_service_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (home_hub_id) REFERENCES rail_hub(hub_id)
);
CREATE TABLE departure (
    departure_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    service_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    segment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    arrival_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_fare REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (segment_id) REFERENCES line_segment(segment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES rolling_unit(unit_id)
);
CREATE TABLE crew_member (
    crew_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    given_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    family_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    qualification_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    assigned_hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_hub_id) REFERENCES rail_hub(hub_id)
);
CREATE TABLE assignment (
    assignment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    departure_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    crew_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duty_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    check_in_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (departure_id) REFERENCES departure(departure_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (crew_id) REFERENCES crew_member(crew_id),

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE outlets (
    outlet_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    network_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    outlet_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    postal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE employees (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (outlet_id) REFERENCES outlets(outlet_id)
);
CREATE TABLE suppliers (
    supplier_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    supplier_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    rating REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE medicines (
    medicine_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_ingredient TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    prescription_required INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id)
);
CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    preferred_outlet_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (preferred_outlet_id) REFERENCES outlets(outlet_id)
);
CREATE TABLE stock_levels (
    stock_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    medicine_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reorder_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_delivery TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (outlet_id) REFERENCES outlets(outlet_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medicine_id) REFERENCES medicines(medicine_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id)
);
CREATE TABLE dispensations (
    dispensation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dispensed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (outlet_id) REFERENCES outlets(outlet_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(employee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE dispensation_items (
    item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dispensation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    medicine_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (dispensation_id) REFERENCES dispensations(dispensation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medicine_id) REFERENCES medicines(medicine_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_stock_outlet_medicine ON stock_levels(outlet_id, medicine_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_dispensations_date ON dispensations(dispensed_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_items_medicine ON dispensation_items(medicine_id);","data":"INSERT INTO outlets VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE dance_room (
    room_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    room_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE coach (
    coach_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    room_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES dance_room(room_id)
);

CREATE TABLE member (
    member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    membership_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE session_slot (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    dance_style TEXT NOT NULL,
    skill_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fee REAL NOT NULL,
    room_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    coach_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES dance_room(room_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (coach_id) REFERENCES coach(coach_id)
);

CREATE TABLE enrollment (
    enrollment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enrolled_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendance_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES session_slot(session_id),
    UNIQUE (member_id, session_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_coach_room ON coach(room_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_session_date ON session_slot(session_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_session_style ON session_slot(dance_style);
CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_member ON enrollment(member_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_session ON enrollment(session_id);","data":"INSERT INTO dance_room (room_id, room_name, city, address, floor_number, capacity) VALUES

    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    water_source TEXT NOT NULL,
    annual_capacity_kg INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE rearing_units (

    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    unit_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    volume_liters INTEGER NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE venue (venue_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, venue_name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT NOT NULL, district TEXT NOT NULL, opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL, venue_type TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE production (production_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, genre TEXT NOT NULL, company_name TEXT NOT NULL, duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, age_rating TEXT NOT NULL);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE org_unit (
    org_unit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    unit_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    unit_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    cost_center TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE staff_member (
    staff_member_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    org_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    given_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    family_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    base_monthly REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (org_unit_id) REFERENCES org_unit(org_unit_id)
);
CREATE TABLE pay_cycle (
    pay_cycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_label TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    period_start TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_end TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    cycle_status TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE payroll_batch (
    payroll_batch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    pay_cycle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    org_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    batch_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    processed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    approval_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (pay_cycle_id) REFERENCES pay_cycle(pay_cycle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (org_unit_id) REFERENCES org_unit(org_unit_id)
);
CREATE TABLE salary_statement (
    salary_statement_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    payroll_batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    statement_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    gross_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    deduction_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    net_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    statement_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (payroll_batch_id) REFERENCES payroll_batch(payroll_batch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (staff_member_id) REFERENCES staff_member(staff_member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE earning_catalog (
    earning_catalog_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    earning_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    earning_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    component_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    taxable INTEGER NOT NULL,
    recurring INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE pay_line (
    pay_line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    salary_statement_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    earning_catalog_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity REAL NOT NULL,
    unit_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    line_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (salary_statement_id) REFERENCES salary_statement(salary_statement_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (earning_catalog_id) REFERENCES earning_catalog(earning_catalog_id)
);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE residence (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    postal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    manager_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    built_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE stairwell (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    residence_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (residence_id) REFERENCES residence(id)
);
CREATE TABLE unit (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    stairwell_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    area_m2 REAL NOT NULL,
    unit_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    occupancy_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (stairwell_id) REFERENCES stairwell(id)
);
CREATE TABLE coproprietor (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    joined_on TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE ownership (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    coproprietor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    share_percent REAL NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES unit(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (coproprietor_id) REFERENCES coproprietor(id)
);
CREATE TABLE assessment (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    residence_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    period_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    period_quarter INTEGER NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (residence_id) REFERENCES residence(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES unit(id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    assessment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    coproprietor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    reference_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id) REFERENCES assessment(id),

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE destinations (
    destination_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    climate TEXT NOT NULL,
    airport_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    popularity_score INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE holiday_offers (
    offer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    destination_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    offer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    travel_style TEXT NOT NULL,
    nights INTEGER NOT NULL,
    base_price REAL NOT NULL,
    min_age INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_id) REFERENCES destinations(destination_id)
);
CREATE TABLE departures (
    departure_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    offer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    return_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seats_left INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (offer_id) REFERENCES holiday_offers(offer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    loyalty_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE reservations (
    reservation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    departure_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booked_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    travelers_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (departure_id) REFERENCES departures(departure_id)
);
CREATE TABLE reservation_guests (
    guest_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    meal_preference TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(reservation_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_offers_destination ON holiday_offers(destination_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_departures_offer_date ON departures(offer_id, departure_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_reservations_client ON reservations(client_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_reservations_departure ON reservations(departure_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_guests_reservation ON reservation_guests(reservation_id);","data":"INSERT INTO destinations (destination_id, country, city, region, climate, airport_code, popularity_score) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE species (
    species_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    common_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    scientific_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    typical_lifespan_years INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE zones (
    zone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    zone_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    zone_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    location TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE animals (
    animal_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    species_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sex TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_year INTEGER,
    intake_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    temperament TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (species_id) REFERENCES species(species_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES zones(zone_id)
);
CREATE TABLE staff (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE adopters (
    adopter_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    housing_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    has_yard INTEGER NOT NULL,
    approved_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE care_events (
    event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staff_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL,
    cost_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animals(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(staff_id)
);
CREATE TABLE adoptions (
    adoption_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    adopter_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    adoption_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    fee_eur REAL NOT NULL,
    follow_up_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id) REFERENCES animals(animal_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (adopter_id) REFERENCES adopters(adopter_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_animals_species ON animals(species_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_animals_status ON animals(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_care_events_animal_date ON care_events(animal_id, event_date);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE brewery_site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beer_style (
    style_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    style_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    fermentation TEXT NOT NULL,
    typical_abv REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beer (
    beer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    style_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    beer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    abv REAL NOT NULL,
    launch_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    seasonal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES brewery_site(site_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (style_id) REFERENCES beer_style(style_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ingredient (
    ingredient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ingredient_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    ingredient_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    origin_country TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_cost REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beer_ingredient (
    beer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity_kg REAL NOT NULL,
    usage_stage TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (beer_id, ingredient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (beer_id) REFERENCES beer(beer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredient(ingredient_id)
);
CREATE TABLE brew_batch (
    batch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    beer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    brew_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    keg_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    volume_liters INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quality_score REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (beer_id) REFERENCES beer(beer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES brewery_site(site_id)
);
CREATE TABLE taproom_order (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_units INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES brew_batch(batch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES brewery_site(site_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_beer_site ON beer(site_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_beer_style ON beer(style_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_batch_beer ON brew_batch(beer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_order_date ON taproom_order(order_date);","data":"INSERT INTO brewery_site (site_id, site_name, city, region, opened_year) VALUES

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    telephone TEXT,
    ville TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_inscription TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE employes (
    employe_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialite TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_embauche TEXT NOT NULL,
    taux_horaire REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE services_couture (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    libelle TEXT NOT NULL,
    categorie TEXT NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire REAL NOT NULL,
    duree_jours INTEGER NOT NULL
);

    commande_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    employe_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_depot TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_livraison_prevue TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_estime REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (employe_id) REFERENCES employes(employe_id)
);
CREATE TABLE commande_services (
    commande_service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite INTEGER NOT NULL,
    prix_applique REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes_atelier(commande_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services_couture(service_id)
);

    montant REAL NOT NULL,
    mode_paiement TEXT NOT NULL,
    statut TEXT NOT NULL,

);

    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    company_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sector TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    contract_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_since TEXT NOT NULL
);

    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,

    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL,
    access_notes TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(client_id)
);

    agent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    certification TEXT NOT NULL,
    hire_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
);

    mission_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mission_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    shift_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    required_agents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    supervisor_agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES sites(site_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supervisor_agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id)
);
CREATE TABLE assignments (
    mission_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    hours_worked REAL NOT NULL,
    attendance TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (mission_id, agent_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (mission_id) REFERENCES missions(mission_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(agent_id)

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE organizer (
    organizer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sector TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE hall (
    hall_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    hall_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    floor_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    area_sqm INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hourly_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    accessibility_level TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE congress (
    congress_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    organizer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_attendees INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (organizer_id) REFERENCES organizer(organizer_id)
);
CREATE TABLE session (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    congress_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hall_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    session_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_time TEXT NOT NULL,
    speaker_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (congress_id) REFERENCES congress(congress_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (hall_id) REFERENCES hall(hall_id)
);
CREATE TABLE attendee (
    attendee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    organization TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    attendee_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    registration_date TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE registration (

    congress_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

);

CREATE INDEX idx_session_congress ON session(congress_id);

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE researcher (
    researcher_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    specialty TEXT NOT NULL,
    institution TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_since INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE archaeological_site (
    site_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    period_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
    site_type TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE excavation_campaign (
    campaign_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    director_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    campaign_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    funding_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES archaeological_site(site_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (director_id) REFERENCES researcher(researcher_id)
);

CREATE TABLE context_unit (
    context_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    parent_context_id INTEGER,
    context_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    depth_cm INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sediment TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES excavation_campaign(campaign_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_context_id) REFERENCES context_unit(context_id)
);

CREATE TABLE artifact (
    artifact_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    context_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    recorder_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    inventory_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    material TEXT NOT NULL,
    condition_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    estimated_date INTEGER NOT NULL,
    weight_g REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (context_id) REFERENCES context_unit(context_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (recorder_id) REFERENCES researcher(researcher_id)
);

CREATE TABLE artifact_analysis (
    analysis_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    artifact_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    analyst_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    analysis_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    analysis_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    confidence_score REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (artifact_id) REFERENCES artifact(artifact_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (analyst_id) REFERENCES researcher(researcher_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_site ON excavation_campaign(site_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_context_campaign ON context_unit(campaign_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_context ON artifact(context_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_analysis_artifact ON artifact_analysis(artifact_id);","data":"INSERT INTO researcher (researcher_id, full_name, specialty, institution, active_since) VALUES

    branch_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    neighborhood TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seats INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE barista (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    hired_on TEXT NOT NULL,

);

    price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,

{"ddl":"CREATE TABLE funeral_home (
    home_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    home_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    region TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    license_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);
CREATE TABLE family_account (
    family_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    home_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    contact_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT NOT NULL,
    postal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (home_id) REFERENCES funeral_home(home_id)
);
CREATE TABLE deceased_person (
    deceased_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    family_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    given_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    family_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    birth_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    death_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    burial_city TEXT NOT NULL,
    disposition_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES family_account(family_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (home_id) REFERENCES funeral_home(home_id)
);
CREATE TABLE ceremony (
    ceremony_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    deceased_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    home_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ceremony_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    ceremony_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    venue TEXT NOT NULL,
    guest_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ceremony_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (deceased_id) REFERENCES deceased_person(deceased_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (home_id) REFERENCES funeral_home(home_id)
);
CREATE TABLE service_catalog (
    service_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    service_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    tax_rate REAL NOT NULL,
    availability TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE ceremony_service (
    ceremony_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agreed_price REAL NOT NULL,
    provider_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ceremony_id, service_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ceremony_id) REFERENCES ceremony(ceremony_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES service_catalog(service_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment_record (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    ceremony_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    family_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (ceremony_id) REFERENCES ceremony(ceremony_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES family_account(family_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_family_home ON family_account(home_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_deceased_family ON deceased_person(family_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ceremony_date ON ceremony(ceremony_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_payment_date ON payment_record(payment_date);","data":"INSERT INTO funeral_home (home_id, home_name, city, region, phone, license_code) VALUES
